Work request: investigate whether the invoice identified in this packet has been settled as of the snapshot date. The request itself is not evidence that any payment occurred or that anyone owes a reply.

work_item.reason: Work request: investigate whether the invoice identified in this packet has been settled as of the snapshot date.

retrieval.description: Exactly the source rows and collision members declared in this synthetic packet.
limitations: No production discovery or absence claim.

adjudication.family_description: A Stripe payout net of fees with its payout report present; the same evidence with and without the packet assembler's authored relationship; and the same pair for a payout that bundles a second charge.
adjudication.error_mode: fee-netted payout: the fee is stated only in the report; without an authored relationship the allocation must be inferred from the balance and grounded on the report
adjudication.label_reason: Identical evidence without the authored relationship; the same accounting expectation as its pair.
adjudication.terminal_reason: Identical evidence without the authored relationship; the same accounting expectation as its pair.
adjudication.positive_evidence: A current scoped payment-specific source connecting the transaction and the obligation, supported semantics, valid amounts, and resolved competing allocations.
contradictions: Conflicting remittances or repeated ambiguous references
Another relevant payment with unresolved allocation
adjudication.model_dependence_definition: ideal composition consumes at least one semantic answer
limitations: Authored synthetic evidence; every source relationship is an assumption, not a verified production fact.
Provisional label written by the authoring session; not independently adjudicated.
Complete only inside the declared fixture manifest; not all possible books evidence.

REPRESENTATION LIMIT (recorded, not hidden): without the relationship the menu offers the balance on the bank amount with the credit's excess over the balance as other receipts (fee 0, surplus 36452); the invoice's own fee inside a bundled payout is not packet arithmetic and the interface cannot extract it, so the expected plan is unrepresentable on this menu, with the same components named as for its pair.
